title: lichen-link: default-feature test build broken (ungated tests use alloc-gated items)
description: rust/lichen-link/src/sos_origin.rs tests mod — hex_to_bytes (:244) + domain_matches_vector (:259, uses bare Vec) + 3 tracker_* tests + origin_addr_matches_upstream_pinned_vector reference alloc-gated names (Vec via cfg'd use alloc::vec::Vec, OriginSequenceTracker, SOS_ORIGIN_GATE_DEFAULT_CAPACITY) but are not cfg(feature="alloc") gated. cargo test -p lichen-link with default features (no alloc) fails: E0425 'cannot find type Vec', 'cannot find value SOS_ORIGIN_GATE_DEFAULT_CAPACITY', 'cannot find type OriginSequenceTracker'. CI misses it (only all-features/schnorr legs). Fix: gate the alloc-dependent tests with cfg(feature="alloc") and use std::vec::Vec in domain_matches_vector. Refiled — original bead lost in a store merge.
